meta.titre: DQ9Recomp — Dragon Quest IX on PC and Android
meta.description: Unofficial native port of Dragon Quest IX for Windows, Linux and Android. Download the launcher, import your ROM, play.
meta.partage: Dragon Quest IX, rewritten in Rust for Windows, Linux and Android.

accueil.jeu: Dragon Quest IX: Sentinels of the Starry Skies
accueil.accroche: , rewritten in Rust to run natively on PC and phones. Big screen, gamepad, keyboard or touch — and your adventure logs come with you.

dialogue.l2: This port contains no game data.
dialogue.l3: Bring the ROM from your own cartridge: the launcher takes care of the rest.

telecharger.windows: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit. Unzip, then run dq9-runtime.exe.
telecharger.android: 64-bit phones, Android 8 or later. Built-in touch controls.

faq.r1: No. It’s a native engine, written in Rust from a reading of the game’s ARM code: neither emulation nor static recompilation. Hence the high resolution and smoothness.
faq.q2: Why do I need my own ROM?
faq.r2: The project distributes no game data. The launcher checks the ROM (code YDQP), then extracts its assets locally. Any other version is refused with an explanation.
faq.q3: Can I keep my DS save?
faq.r3: Yes: on the launcher’s Adventure Logs page, “Import a DS save” accepts .sav and .dsv files.
faq.r4: Keyboard, gamepad, mouse or touch. Controls can be remapped in the launcher; on Android, a touch gamepad appears in game.
